verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a versioned, resource-oriented REST API with a full OpenAPI 3.0 reference and an endpoint for pushing raw data. These support non-interactive, scripted automation. Its MCP docs also explicitly describe a mode for setups with no browser, such as CI jobs and scripts. Missing for 10: the CI/headless MCP auth flow is only partially shown (the snippet is truncated), there is no official CLI or ready-made CI integration (e.g. a pipeline action), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
